title: Insurgent
author: Veronica Roth
summary: The second book of a dystopian trilogy set in a city split into factions defined by a single virtue. The simmering conflict between factions turns to open war, and Tris must decide whom to trust.
readIf: you like quick, plot-driven young adult dystopia with a conflicted heroine.
skipIf: you haven't read the first book, as it follows on directly and assumes you know the setup.

pairings.reason: The model for this genre, with sharper stakes and a more resourceful narrator.
Another teen rebel caught between the regime and its enemies, with plenty of twists.
A fast dystopian story with a cat-and-mouse dynamic and two very different leads.
